verdict.rationale: Composio documents unattended, browserless sign-in (`composio login --agent`), a CLI that gives terminals and coding agents a tool surface, and programmatic SDK sessions, so it can plausibly run headlessly. However, nothing documents CI usage, and connecting app accounts depends on a user opening a Connect Link, which limits fully non-interactive automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation (e.g. API-key or environment-variable auth in CI runners, CI examples), a documented non-interactive path for connecting app accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use `composio login --agent` to create a Composio agent account and sign in without a browser or a separate email signup.
The Composio CLI gives coding agents and terminals a local tool surface.
